title: /ops/ui opens on a Desktop App area first in its rail; its switches change GET /api/desktop/config and leave GET /api/ui alone
steps: S1: Common setup (README.md for a local stand). The ops seat is REG_OPS_SEAT (letter or address, default `a`), an owner or admin of the tracy_admin workspace. Read GET /api/desktop/config with no cookie: record status, cache-control and body. Read GET /api/ui and GET /api/ui?surface=desktop with no cookie.
S2: As the ops seat, PUT /api/ops/desktop {"llm":{"connect":false,"providers":["claude"]}} so both presses below change something.
S3: Browser: a NEW context signed in as the ops seat; open $O/ops/ui. Read the rail links `nav a[href^="?area="]`.
S4: Press the switch named `Let customers connect their own model plan`; then read GET /api/desktop/config.
S5: Press the switch named `ChatGPT Codex`; then read GET /api/desktop/config.
S6: Read GET /api/ui again. Finally PUT /api/ops/desktop back to the llm block recorded in S1.
expect: S1: /api/desktop/config answers 200 with cache-control no-store and exactly the keys llm and tracyModel; /api/ui answers exactly the key hidden, and ?surface=desktop answers the same hidden list.
S3: the first rail link reads `Desktop App` and carries aria-current=page; the connect switch is off and the ChatGPT Codex switch is disabled.
S4: llm is {connect:true, providers:[claude]} and the ChatGPT Codex switch is enabled.
S5: llm is {connect:true, providers:[claude, codex]} (the screen's order).
S6: /api/ui still answers only hidden, with the same list as S1.
evidence: PR #1015 replaced a per-switch Desktop column (ui_setting.desktop_overrides, /api/ui?surface=desktop) with one Desktop App area holding the app's own settings (07/10/2026).
fence: Mechanism only: the screen writes the desktop_setting row and the public door reads it back. Not covered: the desktop app reading the door (not built yet).
